question: The pact signed between the Indian National Congress and All India Muslim League in 1916 is called as
solution:
The Correct Answer **__Lucknow Pact__**__.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The pact signed between the Indian National Congress and All India Muslim League in 1916 is called **Lucknow Pact.**
 
• A Joint Session between these parties held in **Lucknow.**
 
• **The president of the 1916 Lucknow session was Ambica Charan Mazumdar.**
 
• **Indian National Congress** was headed by **Maratha leader Bal Gangadhar Tilak.**
 
• **Indian Muslim League **was headed by **Mohammad Ali Jinnah**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
